successCriteria.description: docs/DOMAIN.md contains a line that is exactly `## balance` starting at column 0 (a level-2 ATX heading), and no line in the file contains a table row immediately followed by `##` on the same line (i.e. the pattern `|## ` no longer matches anywhere in the file).

The `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table in docs/DOMAIN.md is intact: its header row, separator row, and all eight data rows (status, leaveTypeId, startDateFrom, startDateTo, endDateFrom, endDateTo, limit, offset) each occupy their own line, and the `offset` row is the last row of that table.

The `balance` section renders as a heading again: the `## balance` heading line is followed by a blank line and then the existing description paragraph ("Represents leave balance data managed by the `balance` module..."), and the `### Balance` / `### LeaveBalance` subsections remain nested under it.

The repair is content-preserving: no prose, table row, field, type, or heading text in docs/DOMAIN.md is added, removed, reworded, or reordered — the only change is the line break between the `offset` row and `## balance`. The file's set of level-2 headings is unchanged apart from `balance` becoming a heading again.

constraints: The edit is confined to docs/DOMAIN.md. No file under src/, web/, tests/, migrations/, or scripts/ may be modified, and no source, test, or migration behaviour may change — this phase is a documentation-structure repair with zero runtime effect.

The fix must restore the line break only: the `offset` row line ends after its final `|`, then a blank line, then `## balance` at column 0. Do not reflow, re-indent, or reformat any other line, and do not introduce trailing whitespace on the row line.

The `balance` section's body must be left byte-identical to its current content (description paragraph, `### Balance` table, `### LeaveBalance` table, and their Relationships lists). The heading text stays `## balance` — lowercase, matching the sibling section headings (`## leave`, `## employee`, `## policy`, `## notification`, `## audit`, `## validation`, `## system`, `## uptime`).

Do not use this phase to correct the known, separately-recorded DOMAIN.md drift (stale `LeaveRequest.leaveTypeId` / `approvedBy` / `approvedAt`, `EmploymentStatus.INACTIVE`, and the stale `audit` section shapes). Those are documented as pre-existing drift in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and are out of scope here.
outOfScope: Correcting the pre-existing DOMAIN.md drift recorded in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (stale `LeaveRequest.leaveTypeId`/`approvedBy`/`approvedAt`, `EmploymentStatus.INACTIVE`, and the `audit` section's `oldValues`/`newValues`/`performedBy`/`performedAt` shapes).

Any change to the `balance` section's documented entities, fields, or relationships — including reconciling `Balance` and `LeaveBalance` (which currently carry identical field lists) or the `status: string` field against the built balance model.
Adding, removing, or reordering any section of docs/DOMAIN.md, and any change to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, .gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json, or other documentation files.
Adding a lint/CI check, script, or test that validates markdown structure in docs/ — the phase is the one-line repair, not new tooling.

ambiguities.description: Scope of the repair: whether the phase fixes only the one reported line break, or also scans docs/DOMAIN.md for any other heading glued to a preceding line and repairs those too.
options: Fix only the reported `offset` row / `## balance` line break (minimal, matches the prescription)
Fix the reported break AND repair any other heading-glued-to-content occurrences found in the same file
Fix the reported break and add a structural check that would catch future occurrences

ambiguities.description: Whether the phase should also record the repair in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (e.g. as a delivered-phase note), given ARCHITECTURE.md is the maintained source of truth and already tracks DOMAIN.md drift.
options: Do not touch docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — the repair is self-evident in DOMAIN.md
Add a short delivered-phase note to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md recording the DOMAIN.md structure repair

ambiguities.description: Whether the `balance` section's pre-existing content drift (identical `Balance`/`LeaveBalance` field lists, `status: string`) should be flagged in the phase output as a follow-up, or left entirely unmentioned.
options: Leave unmentioned — out of scope, already covered by ARCHITECTURE.md's drift notes
Note it in the phase output as a follow-up without editing the section

entityInvariants.invariant: The `balance` section is a level-2 ATX heading that begins its own line at column 0 (`## balance`), is preceded by a blank line, and is followed by a blank line before its description paragraph. It is never a continuation of a preceding table row. Its body (description, `### Balance`, `### LeaveBalance`, Relationships lists) is unchanged.

The table remains a well-formed markdown table: header row, separator row, and exactly the eight existing data rows, one per line, each terminated by `|` with nothing appended after it. The `offset` row is the table's final row and is immediately followed by a blank line.

interfaceConstraints.operation: In-place repair of the docs/DOMAIN.md `balance` heading line break (a file-level documentation contract, not an API operation — no route, verb, or payload is involved)
interfaceConstraints.authRule: None — documentation only; no authentication, authorization, or RBAC surface is touched.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: No runtime error semantics. The only failure mode is a malformed result: if the row and heading remain on one line, or if any other line of the file changes, the repair has failed. The file must remain valid UTF-8 markdown with no trailing whitespace introduced.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The repaired heading must match the formatting convention of the sibling level-2 section headings in the same file — `## leave`, `## employee`, `## policy`, `## notification`, `## audit`, `## validation`, `## system`, `## uptime` — i.e. `## ` + lowercase section name at column 0, with a blank line before and after. Do not introduce a different heading level or casing for `balance`.

The `balance` section's documented content must stay consistent with what docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and .gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json record for the balance module — this phase changes only the heading's line placement, so the section body must not be edited to "fix" any perceived mismatch. Any such mismatch is pre-existing drift and must be flagged, not silently corrected here.

The `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table's rows must continue to describe the same type that `src/shared/types/index.ts` declares as `LeaveRequestQueryParams` (the canonical shared type consumed by leave.repository.ts, leave.service.ts and leave.routes.ts). The repair must not alter any row's field name, type, or required flag.

integrationPoints.why: The single file this phase edits; the `## balance` heading at line 96 must be restored to its own line so the section renders as a heading again.
The maintained architecture document that already records DOMAIN.md's known drift; the repair must not contradict it and must not be used to resolve that drift.
Authoritative reconciled entity shapes; the balance section's documented entities must not be edited to diverge from it in this phase.
